description: A React functional component for viewing and editing tag details, including fetching data from APIs, editing form, and displaying tag information with budget details.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Asynchronously copies provided text to clipboard and updates UI state to show success feedback.

methods.name: fetchTagDetails
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific tag using API call and updates component state.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Handles saving updates to the tag details by calling the update API and managing UI feedback.
